N4571A-27-R-0002 Page 13 of 106 Truth-seeking means the LLM is truthful in responding to user prompts seeking factual information or analysis. The LLM prioritizes historical accuracy, scientific inquiry, and objectivity, and acknowledges uncertainty where reliable information is incomplete or contradictory. Ideological Neutrality means the LLM is a neutral, nonpartisan tool that does not manipulate responses in favor of ideological dogmas. Significant Modifications means any changes made by the contractor or subcontractor to the AI model that could reasonably be expected to alter its adherence to the Unbiased AI Principles. For the purposes of compliance with the Unbiased AI Principles, this definition includes, but is not limited to, changes to training data and model architecture, and alterations to filtering and content moderation. (b) Contractor Obligation. The contractor must ensure that any LLM or other AI model provided under this contract complies with the Unbiased AI Principles throughout the period of performance. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

REPUBLIC OF TAJIKISTAN

TAJIKISTAN DIGITAL FOUNDATIONS PROJECT

Date: November 9, 2026

Assignment Title: Consultancy Service for Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals

Reference No.: PIC-TDFP-CS-3

State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan is implementing Tajikistan Digital Foundation Project (thereafter referred to as Project) co-financed by the World Bank and the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC). The total cost of the project is US$46.2 million, of which the IDA grant is $30M, SDC Trust fund is $14.8M and GoTJ share is $1.4M. and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include the Advanced Digital Skills Trainings for 1,000 individuals

 

The consultant will have to perform the following tasks:

Tasks

s, inclusivity considerations, infrastructure constraints, and applicability of skills.
  • Develop of complementary business soft skills training modules, that will be delivered in Russian and Tajik to enhance participants’ readiness for employment and further skills development.
  • Ensure blended and online delivery modalities through the Platform for Educational Needs, describing delivery options, sequencing, and implementation considerations to support regional equity of access and sustainability beyond the project period.
  • Develop an inclusive outreach and participant selection framework, including eligibility criteria and targeting approaches, to support the participation of youth, NEET populations, women, persons with disabilities, and beneficiaries in line with the inclusion targets defined in the Objective section.
  • Develop and adapt training curricula and learning materials in Russian, English, and/or Tajik, leveraging and contextualizing existing resources available in Tajikistan and identifying gaps where supplementary materials may be required.
  • Develop and implement employer engagement mechanisms to facilitate internships and job matching for the course beneficiaries.
  • The Consultant shall track employment outcomes fo

jectives.
  • Transfer full documentation, training materials (free of copyrights) to PIC EOP upon contract completion.

    •  

    Duration

    The total duration of the contract is 24 months.

     

    The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1avZ1BiaGMRme-LLyzJU5MgukzT2-brdg/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=101229496586602350179&rtpof=true&sd=true

    The State Institution "Projects Implementation Center for Tajikistan Digital Foundations" of the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Tajikistan now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

    The shortlisting criteria are:

    (i) At least 3 years of experience in designing and delivering educational programs.

    (ii) Demonstrated experience in designing and implementation managing large-scale digital skills and workforce development programs of at least 800–1000 participants within

e Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 08:00 to 17:00 hours.

Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. The Government of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Technical Assistance Facility under the Learning Acceleration in Secondary Education (LAISE) Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include undertaking a comprehensive assessment of ICT infrastructure and institutional readiness, the status and readiness of Multimedia Classrooms (MMCs), and teachers’ competencies and readiness to deliver ICT-enabled teaching using ICT facilities and MMCs.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.dshe.gov.bd or can be obtained at the address given below. The duration of the assignment will be about 06 (Six) months. The assignment is expected to commence in March 2027.

The Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education now invites eligible firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers.
